newsitem.title: USA: Haas Wheat & Partners buys SMC Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Haas Wheat & Partners buys SMC Holdings.

text.p: Haas Wheat & Partners Inc., a Dallas-based investment firm, said Thursday it acquired SMC Holdings Corp. for $113.5 million from Castle Harlan Partners II LP.
SMC Holdings is the parent company of Smarte Carte, an operator of baggage cart rental systems at airports and bus stations.
Smarte Carte operates in 146 U.S. and 13 international airports, seven train stations and four bus stations, Haas Wheat said. The company also offers stroller rentals in shopping malls.
